name: neon-api-audit
description: Does Neon's API do what its docs say? Every read endpoint, checked against the published spec.

scripts.static:spectral: spectral lint spec/v2.json --ruleset rules/.spectral.yaml --format json --output runs/run0-spectral.json
scripts.static:redocly: redocly lint spec/v2.json --config rules/redocly.yaml --format json > runs/run0-redocly.json
